label: copy phase: fed-back input m (weaker g), mid/late copy positions
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never in original or delimiter steps), and only on repeated tokens (in_first=0). About 76% of activation mass is on steps whose fed-back input is m; another 16% is on g, with a little j/k. Most of it falls at recall_idx 3-5 (t around 10-13). It never fires at recall_idx 0-1 and is weak on the final output step. The largest activations are on m at recall_idx 3-4 that follows b, w or e. The input token is necessary but not sufficient: only about 13% of copy-phase m inputs activate it. Adding previous-token context (b/w/e/k/z/d/h) raises precision to 0.47 but loses recall, so the full gating condition is not captured. Does not depend on digit count or on whether the copy so far is correct.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=11: m, g, j, k; t=12: m, g, j, k; t=10: m, g, k, j) and the previous input (most: b, w, e, m, k, z; least: p, a, 1, q); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=5, L=4 & t=6, recall_idx=3.
